C0760.title: Shanghai Releases 2025 Network Data Security Enforcement Cases
keywords: standard contract for personal information export
C0760.summary: On January 16, 2026, the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration released typical enforcement cases from 2025, noting that some involved enterprises failed to properly implement data export requirements, leading to unauthorized data transfers and creating personal information security risks.
